matrix.description: Full preset × race × profile sweep. Profiles change one baseline stat at a time, except regeneration profiles which jointly change spirit and mp5. All stats are bonuses above racial/class bases. Gear-free, 180s, zero distance, external CoE only, no consumables. Source APLs are retained, including their race-specific action IDs; this measures import behavior rather than optimizing each race's rotation.

baseline.description: Bonus stats above racial/class base; empty gear, external Curse of Elements only, no other external buffs or consumables. Assigned curse disabled.
